description: The file defines a Java class 'VerhoeffIdentifierValidator' that implements a validation algorithm for identifiers using the Verhoeff check digit method, extending functionality from a base class 'BaseHyphenatedIdentifierValidator'. It includes methods for validation, check digit calculation, and identifier formatting, with specific rules around length and character restrictions.

classes.name: VerhoeffIdentifierValidator
classes.description: A Java class that validates identifiers using the Verhoeff checksum algorithm, ensuring identifiers are of correct length and format, and disallowing numeric check digits.

methods.name: getAllowedCharacters
methods.description: Returns the characters allowed in the identifier, specifically digits 0-9.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the validator, 'Verhoeff Check Digit Validator.'

methods.name: getCheckDigit
methods.description: Calculates and returns the Verhoeff check digit for a given undecorated identifier.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the identifier for correct length, character restrictions, and check digit rules; throws exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a valid identifier string after validation, or throws exception if not valid.

methods.name: getBase
methods.description: Helper method to decompose a number into an array of its digit components.

methods.name: insertCheck
methods.description: Calculates and inserts the Verhoeff check digit into the identifier's representation.

methods.name: VerhoeffIdentifierValidator
methods.description: Constructor initializing lookup tables used in the Verhoeff checksum calculation.
